text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of work. These tasks are often written as user stories that describe what a user needs. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to share progress and solve problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt quickly, improve continuously, and deliver working products faster.
